subject: Post-call: Pinecrest privacy Qs — what we store, where, and for how long
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@pinecrest.health>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Pinecrest privacy Qs — what we store, where, and for how long

Hi Elaine — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap of the privacy/retention items you raised and proposed next steps so we have the same action list.

Summary of asks from your team:
- Confirm exactly which prompt/response fields are persisted for hosted vs dedicated/private deployments.
- Provide default retention windows (TTL) for prompts, outputs, embeddings, and system logs.
- Confirm data residency options and where logs/audit records live.
- Evidence: SOC 2 report, DPA, and our answered security questionnaire.

Our immediate answers (high level):
- Hosted API (default): prompt and generated text are ephemeral by default and NOT used for model training. By default we keep raw prompt/response payloads for 72 hours for operational troubleshooting; you can opt-out to 0 days in the contract.
- Embeddings / vector cache: retained up to 30 days by default, configurable down to 0 days for Dedicated/Private.
- KV/prefix cache: internal runtime caches only, evicted according to workload; not persisted to durable storage unless you configure a persistent store.
- Audit logs & traces: security/audit logs retained 180 days (can be exported to your SIEM).
- Billing and usage metering: retained per billing policy (2 years) for invoicing and dispute resolution.
- Residency: we can pin inference and storage to US (us-east-1) or EU (eu-central-1). For Pinecrest you requested US-only.

Attachments: I attached a draft retention matrix (pinecrest-retention-matrix.xlsx) and our completed security questionnaire stub.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to send retention matrix + questionnaire answers (attached) — DONE.
2) Pinecrest to confirm any fields that must be 0-day or region-restricted.
3) Technical deep dive with Vivek and Aditya to confirm KMS and log export options (45 min).
4) If needed, we can scope Dedicated capacity with a 0-day retention addendum.

Can you confirm availability for a technical call Thurs or Fri this week? If you want, open items you want us to put into the matrix explicitly (e.g., PHI fields vs session metadata).

- Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: pinecrest-retention-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), pinecrest-security-questionnaire-answers.pdf (pdf)

From: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@pinecrest.health>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pinecrest Security <security@pinecrest.health>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Pinecrest privacy Qs — what we store, where, and for how long

Thanks Ben — helpful summary. A couple clarifications from our side before we schedule the deep dive: 

1) By "prompt and generated text are ephemeral by default (72 hours)" — does that include intermediate partial responses (streamed tokens) or only final assembled outputs? We need to know whether streamed chunks could be persisted in any diagnostic logs.
2) For embeddings: our legal team wants them treated as persistent PII if they are derived from patient notes. Can you confirm whether embeddings are reversible and whether Redwood will treat them as first-class PII when stored?
3) Audit logs retained 180 days is acceptable for now; we'd like an option to push logs to our Splunk instance nightly.
4) Can you confirm which artifacts appear in support bundles when we open an escalation? We want to ensure PHI is never included.

We can do Thursday morning (08:30–09:30 ET) for the technical call. Please include your security lead.

Regards,
Elaine Chu
Director of Digital Products
Pinecrest Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@pinecrest.health>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 11:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Pinecrest privacy Qs — what we store, where, and for how long

Great questions — answered inline below and I’ve cc’d our security and solutions folks to confirm.

Elaine — answers: 
- Streamed tokens: by default we treat streamed partial tokens as ephemeral transient buffers and we DO NOT write them to durable storage. Support bundles will contain only final assembled outputs (if you enable diagnostic capture). We can set diagnostic capture to exclude any text fields that match PHI regexes.
- Embeddings reversibility: embeddings are numeric vectors derived from models; they are not reversible to original text in any reliable way. However, because they can encode semantic content, we treat embeddings as sensitive when customers request that protection. For Pinecrest we can treat embeddings as PII-equivalent: store them only in your selected region and with a 30-day default TTL and immediate purge option.
- Support bundles & escalations: support bundles are configurable. By default they include request metadata, model/version, timing, and anonymized traces. We will NOT include raw prompt/response text or embeddings in support bundles unless you opt-in.
- Logs export: yes — we provide a nightly log export to S3/GCS and can push to your Splunk via S3-to-Splunk connector.

Concrete commitments for the matrix: 
- Hosted API: prompt+response TTL = 72 hours by default; option to contract 0 days.
- Dedicated/Private: configurable TTL down to 0 days; can be set to not persist prompts at all.
- Embeddings: default 30 days; can be set to 0 days in Dedicated or Private.
- Audit/trace logs: 180 days (exportable).
- Support bundles: no PHI by default; manual inclusion only with explicit opt-in and redaction.

I attached the retention matrix with these values filled in. Monica — can you add a one-line summary of redaction options and the support-bundle template? Aditya — can you confirm KMS/HSM options and whether we can offer Pinecrest customer-managed keys for their Dedicated deployment?

Ben

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@pinecrest.health>
Date: Thu, 24 Aug 2028 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Pinecrest privacy Qs — what we store, where, and for how long

Thanks — adding the technical confirmation and a few options we can contractually offer. Quoting Ben's summary above for context.

Technical confirmations: 
- KMS / key management: For Dedicated we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK). For Private (on-prem) we can integrate with your HSM. Keys can be rotated on your cadence; object-level envelopes are used so data at rest is encrypted with customer KMS.
- Data residency: we can pin output storage, embeddings, and audit logs to us-east-1 (US) as requested. All exports to Splunk/S3 will remain in the selected region.
- Retention enforcement: TTLs are enforced by lifecycle jobs — once TTL expires objects are cryptographically shredded (metadata removed and storage deleted). We keep an immutable audit record of deletion events (no content).
- Support bundle content: by default contains: request id, model id, timestamp, per-route metrics, and anonymized trace IDs. Excluded by default: prompt text, streamed token buffer, embeddings. If Pinecrest wants a redacted prompt sample for debugging we can provide it with automated regex-based PHI redaction and a one-time signed access link; otherwise we do not include prompts.
- Embeddings sensitivity: while irreversible, we treat embeddings as sensitive on request. We can enable a hashing+salting layer for stored embeddings to make downstream matching require the salt (customer-specific) — effectively preventing cross-tenant matching if you request it.

Documentation & evidence: 
- I uploaded our SOC 2 Type II attestation and DPA answers (attached PDF).
- For the technical call: proposed agenda — KMS options (10m), retention lifecycle (10m), support bundle template and redaction (15m), log export mechanics (10m).

If Pinecrest confirms Thursday 08:30 ET, Vivek and I will join. If you want more legal-level language about "no training" and retention guarantees we can draft a 1-pager addendum for inclusion in the SOW.

-Aditya
Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
